title: Linear extraction of rational tangent coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $x\in X$, $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $K=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field], and $s:k\to R$ the structural map. Suppose $r=\operatorname{res}\circ s:k\to K$ is bijective. Let $T=T_{X/k,x}$ be the dual-number tangent space with its prescribed vector operations [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space]. Restrict scalars of $T$ and $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ along $r$, where $\mathfrak m$ is the maximal ideal of $R$. For a tangent vector $\theta$ whose closed point is $x$, write $\theta^\sharp:R\to K[\epsilon]$ for its transported closed-point stalk homomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring]. There is a $k$-linear map $L:T\to\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2,k)$ such that for each $\theta$ its closed point maps to $x$ and there is an additive map $D:R\to k$ with $\theta^\sharp(a)=\operatorname{res}(a)+r(D(a))\epsilon$ for all $a\in R$, $L(\theta)([a])=D(a)$ for $a\in\mathfrak m$, and $D(s(c))=0$ for every $c\in k$. No injectivity or surjectivity is asserted.

proof.text: Use coefficient descent to get C and its additive coefficient maps D, vanishing on the structural field and agreeing on maximal-ideal representatives.

Taking second coordinates of the descent formula gives the hypotheses of operation compatibility. Apply that statement, bundle C and its two operation laws into a linear map L, and retain its pointwise coefficient formulas.

theorem exists_rationalTangent_coefficient_linearMap
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) :
    let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let K := X.residueField x
    let s : k →+* R := (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (p x) ≫ p.stalkMap x).hom
    let r : k →+* K :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (p x) ≫ p.stalkMap x ≫ X.residue x).hom
    Function.Bijective r →
    letI : Module k (schemeTangentSpace k X p x) :=
      Module.compHom (schemeTangentSpace k X p x) r
    letI : Module K (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R))
    letI : Module k (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) :=
      Module.compHom (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) r
    ∃ L : schemeTangentSpace k X p x →ₗ[k] (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R →ₗ[k] k),
      ∀ θ : schemeTangentSpace k X p x,
        ∃ hx : θ.val (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (DualNumber K)) = x,
          let sharp : R →+* DualNumber K :=
            (eqToHom (congrArg (fun y : X ↦ X.presheaf.stalk y) hx.symm) ≫
              Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo θ.val).hom
          ∃ D : R →+ k,
            (∀ a : R, sharp a =
              TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((X.residue x).hom a) + TrivSqZeroExt.inr (r (D a))) ∧
            (∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R,
              L θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).toCotangent a) = D a) ∧
            (∀ c : k, D (s c) = 0)
